claims: The Holy Thursday Mass is also known as the Mass of the Lord's Supper.
The Holy Thursday Mass is celebrated on April 2, 2026.
The Holy Thursday Mass marks the beginning of the Easter Triduum.
The Holy Thursday Mass commemorates the Last Supper.
The Holy Thursday Mass commemorates the institution of the Eucharist.
The Holy Thursday Mass commemorates the institution of the Priesthood.
The Holy Thursday Mass commemorates Christ's command to love through service.
The Holy Thursday Mass features the washing of feet.
The Holy Thursday Mass features a procession of the Eucharist.
The Holy Thursday Mass features stripping of the altar.
The Holy Thursday Mass focuses on Jesus' Last Supper with his disciples.
Jesus instituted the Eucharist at his Last Supper with his disciples.
Jesus washed the feet of his disciples at the Last Supper.
The Washing of the Feet is called the Mandatum.
The priest washes the feet of 12 people during the Washing of the Feet.
Following Communion, the Eucharist is carried in procession to the altar of repose.
The main altar is cleared during the Holy Thursday Mass.
The Holy Thursday Mass ends in silence.
Adoration continues through the night after the Holy Thursday Mass.
The Holy Thursday Mass directly links to Good Friday.
The Chrism Mass occurs earlier in the day on Holy Thursday.
Bishops and priests gather at the cathedral for the Chrism Mass.
Bishops and priests bless the oils for sacraments at the Chrism Mass.
Holy Thursday is not a holy day of obligation
